resources.string: OpenPressure %1$s is available. You are using %2$s.\n\nThe download page opens in your browser. Android only installs the update if it comes from the same developer.
No browser found to open the download page.
About once a day, OpenPressure asks GitHub whether a newer version exists. The request contains only the app version; no readings or monitor details are sent.
Update checks contact GitHub about once a day to look for a newer version. You can turn them off under %1$s → %2$s.
